main_text.p: meatu eosdem prohibuerunt: simul frequentibus assultibus Acradinam & Infulam infestarunt: ad hæc navali prælio primum, deinde & terrestri extra urbem tumultuantes superarunt: denique cedere urbe, aut rebus præsentibus acquiescere coegerunt, cum seditio & tumultus biennium durassent. Interim Ducetio Siculo duce coloni Catanenses, quos Hiero ejectis veteribus civibus ibi collocaverat, Catanâ expulsi, urbs indigenis restituta: passim totâ Siciliâ reductis exulibus, alienigenis submotis, pristino statui reddita. Alienigenarum colluvies in extremâ infulæ parte Messanæ constitit. Rempublicæ forma Syracusis ea tum fuit, quam Aristoteles proprie πολιτείαν[?] appellat, ex oligarchiâ & democratiâ mixtam, vel popularem primorum potestate temperatam: quem idem civitatis statum optimum esse censet. Itaque & primores in honore & dignitate præcipuâ fuêre, & populus reliquus suas quoque partes in republica tulit. Verùm post aliquot annos hoc statu adhuc durante, & civium numero iterùm crescente Tyndarides [illegible, ~3 letters]è primoribus vir prædives, ambitionis percitus in summum discrimen libertatem rursum adduxit.[illegible, ~3 letters] Nam egenorum civium multitudinem largi-[illegible, ~3 letters][illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: Scan has a red edge on the left and some show-through. The left-margin fragments are faint and could not be read letter by letter; they are marked as illegible. The Greek word πολιτείαν is uncertain in its accents and marked [?]. The original spelling of "Infulam" and "infulæ" is kept as printed. Long s has been normalised to s throughout.
